    The ray basis of a standard basic algebra #

    Corollary 5.5 (mesh-deformations.tex): "Construction 2.8 and Proposition 4.14 give A ≅ A₀ ≅ kP, where P = ray A₀. This isomorphism preserves endpoint actions and the subspaces M(f,h) of Definition 3.4, and therefore identifies ray A with P. The ray basis is multiplicative, contains the primitive idempotents, and intersects every radical power in a basis by Corollary 3.3."

    Here: the ray basis of A₀ (exists_hasRayBasis_A0) is transported along A ≅ A₀ (hasRayBasis_of_algEquiv) to the pulled-back vertex idempotents, and then, by conjugacy of complete sets of primitive idempotents in a basic algebra, to any given complete set F.
